name: What security features should I look for in a new sliding glass door?

mainEntity.name: What security features should I look for in a new sliding glass door?

acceptedAnswer.text: Modern sliding glass doors offer several enhanced security features. Look for multi-point locking systems that secure the door at several points along the frame. Anti-lift tracks prevent the door from being easily dislodged, and reinforced frames provide greater resistance to forced entry. Laminated or tempered glass also adds a layer of security, as it is more difficult to break. These features contribute to a safer home.
acceptedAnswer.description: Look for multi-point locking systems, anti-lift tracks, reinforced frames, and tempered or laminated glass for enhanced security.
